_note: How to spell Kuwaiti words for Genarabia-ai/Chatterbox_Kuwaiti cloned to Ali (research only). From the user's 12-word listening test, 2026-10-10 (artifact Lr2aurzZi2KxTKoGf8SKw4; spec voice-data/ckkw-spelling-12.json). Applies to this model only; SILMA and the training transcripts keep the 'write what Ali says' convention until tested.
rule_q: Write plain ق for Ali's g: this model already says it the Kuwaiti way. ق beat گ and ج in all 7 tested words (قبل، الوقت، حق، الطريق، فرق، منطقة، قليلة) and in قال (earlier test). Exception from the earlier test: قاعد sounded better as گاعد.

كذا.note: the user: كذا is Saudi, جذي is the Kuwaiti word

باجر.note: good, but should sound a bit nearer ج than ك; no spelling is fully right yet

نقدر.note: all wrong; with ق the word was dropped entirely

أدور.note: all three spellings wrong (also wrong in the first test)

امبارح.note: Kuwaiti says أمس; never write امبارح

open: words where Ali says a real q (موقع، أعتقد، فقط، الطاقة) may now be said with g by this model: untested
unsolved words may need a synonym in scripts or the fine-tune
